cat > /tmp/prepare_campaign.py <<'PY'
import os, zipfile, io, sqlite3, json
from PIL import Image
base=os.path.expanduser('~/workspace/campaign')
out=os.path.expanduser('~/workspace/out')
layerdir=os.path.join(out,'poster_layers')
os.makedirs(layerdir,exist_ok=True)
# Determine the three eligible records directly from the supplied catalog.
con=sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(base,'sku_catalog.db'))
rows=con.execute("""SELECT sku_id,margin_pct FROM skus
WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND region_scope IN ('GLOBAL','NA') AND stock_qty>=50 AND margin_pct>=0.35
ORDER BY margin_pct DESC, sku_id ASC LIMIT 3""").fetchall()
assert len(rows)==3, rows
ids=[r[0] for r in rows]
print('ranked',rows)
# Unpack the original seven full-canvas layers without changing the background.
z=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.join(base,'poster_master.ora'))
orig={i:Image.open(io.BytesIO(z.read(f'data/layer{i}.png'))).convert('RGBA') for i in range(7)}
# Replace the three slot contents with product artwork contained and centered in each 320x320 safe box.
centers=[(260.5,550.5),(610.5,550.5),(960.5,550.5)]
for slot,(sku,c) in enumerate(zip(ids,centers),start=1):
    art=Image.open(os.path.join(base,'assets',sku+'.png')).convert('RGBA')
    art.thumbnail((320,320),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(1200,1600),(0,0,0,0))
    x=round(c[0]-art.width/2); y=round(c[1]-art.height/2)
    layer.alpha_composite(art,(x,y))
    orig[slot]=layer
    print('slot',slot,sku,'original',Image.open(os.path.join(base,'assets',sku+'.png')).size,'scaled',art.size,'at',x,y)
# Save layers in canonical bottom-to-top order (base, slots, badge, grid, footer).
names=['bg_base','slot_1','slot_2','slot_3','promo_badge','price_grid','legal_footer']
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    path=os.path.join(layerdir,n+'.png')
    orig[i].save(path,optimize=True)
# Generate the clean export from bottom to top with only the three promotional overlays hidden.
clean=Image.new('RGBA',(1200,1600),(0,0,0,0))
for i in range(4):
    clean=Image.alpha_composite(clean,orig[i])
clean.convert('RGB').save(os.path.join(out,'product_clean.png'),optimize=True)
# Store the deterministic verification summary alongside ranks/margins.
manifest={
  'ranked_skus':[{'sku_id':sku,'margin':float(margin)} for sku,margin in rows],
  'verification':'Three eligible SKUs ranked by margin; each transparent PNG contained and centered in its 320x320 slot. Seven-layer source keeps original bg_base and overlays; clean export excludes promo_badge, price_grid, and legal_footer at 1200x1600.'
}
with open(os.path.join(out,'manifest_a.json'),'w') as f: json.dump(manifest,f,indent=2); f.write('\n')
print('clean',Image.open(os.path.join(out,'product_clean.png')).size)
PY

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, shutil
root='/home/user/workspace'; src='/tmp/poster/data'; out=root+'/generated'; os.makedirs(out,exist_ok=True)
# base unchanged
shutil.copy(src+'/layer0.png',out+'/layer0.png')
# fonts
fontpaths=['/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf','/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation2/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf']
fp=next(p for p in fontpaths if os.path.exists(p))
reg='/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf'
# slots product images centered in 320x320 safe boxes
for idx,sku in enumerate(['SKU-119','SKU-116','SKU-124'],start=1):
    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(1200,1600),(220,220,220,0))
    asset=Image.open(root+'/campaign/assets/'+sku+'.png').convert('RGBA')
    # contain scaling within 300x300 to safe box, center at box x 110+350*(idx-1), y380
    maxw=maxh=300
    scale=min(maxw/asset.width,maxh/asset.height)
    asset=asset.resize((round(asset.width*scale),round(asset.height*scale)),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    bx=110+350*(idx-1); by=380
    x=bx+(300-asset.width)//2; y=by+(300-asset.height)//2
    layer.alpha_composite(asset,(x,y))
    # SKU label below box to make selected identity explicit
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    d.text((bx,by+308),sku,font=ImageFont.truetype(fp,18),fill=(32,48,70,255))
    layer.save(f'{out}/layer{idx}.png')
# function for color layers preserving full fill semantics
# promo badge layer exact highlight color
badge=Image.new('RGBA',(1200,1600),(217,70,47,220)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(badge)

args.command:
cat >/tmp/create_final_xcf.scm <<'SCM'
(let* ((dir "/home/user/workspace/out/poster_layers/")
       (basepath (string-append dir "bg_base.png"))
       (img (car (gimp-file-load RUN-NONINTERACTIVE basepath basepath)))
       (base-layer (car (gimp-image-get-active-layer img))))
  (gimp-item-set-name base-layer "bg_base")
  (let loop ((specs '(("slot_1" "slot_1.png")
                      ("slot_2" "slot_2.png")
                      ("slot_3" "slot_3.png")
                      ("promo_badge" "promo_badge.png")
                      ("price_grid" "price_grid.png")
                      ("legal_footer" "legal_footer.png"))))
    (if (not (null? specs))
        (let* ((entry (car specs))
               (name (car entry))
               (path (string-append dir (cadr entry)))
               (layer (car (gimp-file-load-layer RUN-NONINTERACTIVE img path))))
          (gimp-image-insert-layer img layer 0 0)
          (gimp-item-set-name layer name)
          (loop (cdr specs)))))
  (gimp-xcf-save RUN-NONINTERACTIVE img base-layer
    "/home/user/workspace/campaign/poster_master.xcf"
    "/home/user/workspace/campaign/poster_master.xcf")
  (gimp-image-delete img))
(gimp-quit 0)
SCM
timeout 20s gimp-console-2.10 -n -i --console-messages --batch-interpreter=plug-in-script-fu-eval -b '(load "/tmp/create_final_xcf.scm")' >/tmp/create_final.log 2>&1; echo rc:$?; cat /tmp/create_final.log; ls -lh ~/workspace/campaign/poster_master.xcf; strings ~/workspace/campaign/poster_master.xcf | grep -E '^(bg_base|slot_[123]|promo_badge|price_grid|legal_footer)$'
